item.title: Tonawanda lifts overnight parking ban
item.description: BUFFALO, N.Y. (WIVB) -- The Town of Tonawanda announced a lift for their overnight parking ban to go into effect Saturday, a sure sign of spring approaching in Western New York. If more snow does come, the town asks residents to park their vehicles off the street to allow for plows to pass through.
